mods.name: MagicAddons Extension Pack
mods.description: Turns on the MagicAddons features that ship switched off.

releases.notes:
## Server and Discord

- Added Connect to MagicAddons Server in the Account category, needed by every feature that uses the MagicAddons server
- Added Discord Reminders: with Discord integration on and your account linked, the MagicAddons Discord app messages you about your greenhouse while the game is closed, and `/greenhouse` in Discord sends a report
- Added Greenhouse Coop: coop members' plots are synced on join, and the setting decides how reminders behave while a coop member is online
- Added `/ma link`: gives a code to run with `/link` in Discord to link your accounts
- Added `/ma gh SyncData`: sends your greenhouse data by hand
- Added `/ma privacy DeleteMe`: deletes everything the server stores for you, including the Discord link
- Added a privacy policy: https://github.com/MagicHappened/MagicAddons/blob/master/PRIVACY.md

## Greenhouse

- Added Chorus Collision chance: simulates the chance that a teleporting chorus breaks a plant at the next tick, with a Loss tolerance setting replacing Ticks Away
- Added a chorus break order to the Prediction shelf, telling you which chorus to break to lower the chance of a chorus destroying your plants
- Added times mutated tracking, to match decay timers to Hypixel's new decay pity system
- Added Chorus Fruit to Break Protection: lets you break the young chorus the break order names (default), or any young chorus
- Added Diagnostic Highlight and a "Diagnose N plants" line, showing which plants to check with the Plant Diagnostics Tool for their times mutated count
- Added the All-in Aloe reset chance to the prediction
- Added a placed marking tool to the greenhouse screen
- Added planner inventory highlight: a blue background on items you need to build your current plot
- Added owned and needed counts (inventory plus sacks) to the Contents shelf of presets
- Added a Decay threshold to the Decay warning (default 6 hours)
- Added Shorter Cane Crops: draws Sugar Cane and Magic Jellybean as only their bottom block, with an optional stage label

## Other new features

- Added XP Orb Hider: hides experience orbs on the ground, optionally only on mining islands
- Added Skip Resource Reload On Close: closing the game while on Hypixel no longer reloads resources on the way out, which made shutdown slow and could crash

## Changes

- Updated for the 0.27.2 Hypixel update: plants at -100% water and fully charged Thunderlings halt instead of dying, decay needs a minimum number of spawned mutations and only decays on the next growth tick, Dead Plants decay, and Flora counts toward the unique crop bonus
- Decay times show "≥" when not certain and are hidden for plants that can't decay
- The Timestalk attribute is read from your attribute shard automatically
- Godseed has its spawn rule
- Spawn chances scale with how many crops surround the spawn spot
- Effect Spread passes on the effects it received
- The prediction slider is remembered per plot, and the prediction shows plants decaying
- Soggybud shows its grow time or "no water" instead of "stalls", since greenhouse plants that haven't mutated never decay
- Some commands are restructured: `/ma feature toggle`, `/ma feature edit`, `/ma gh` and `/ma safari` replace the old forms

## Fixes

- Fixed greenhouses you hadn't entered since logging in not advancing while you stayed online
- Fixed plants briefly missing from a scan, or not recognised, being dropped
- Fixed a new chorus on an older one's spot being treated as the old plant
- Fixed held items on armor stands being matched to the wrong cell, improving Magic Jellybean scanning
- Fixed stage estimates not narrowing over re-scans
- Fixed reading "FULLY GROWN" with the Plant Diagnostics Tool on Glasscorn when it could reset
- Fixed player nameplates causing plant rescans

releases.notes:
## Greenhouse (new)

- Added Greenhouse Planner: shows a saved preset as holograms in your greenhouse, marking what is missing, wrong or in the way
- Added Greenhouse Presets: up to three plots per preset, an in-game editor with undo and redo, target markings and bookmarks
- Added Layout Import and Export: MagicAddons (designed to be short to share), SkyLayouts, SkyMutations and SkyShards
- Added Soft Import: fits a preset around what is already in it and tries to preserve the existing layout
- Added Water Tracking: each plant's water level, how long it lasts, and a water highlight in the world
- Added Harvest Highlight: with a configurable harvestable definition
- Added Break Protection: prevents breaking mutations under a fortune threshold, while the pest debuff is active, or before they are harvestable
- Added Greenhouse Reminders: ready to harvest, water, decay, Snoozling asleep, Noctilume time, Fleshtrap meat, Thunderling charge, Glasscorn reset and Chorus collision, before and at the growth tick (works for other profiles too)
- Added Greenhouse Prediction: see your greenhouse up to 10 ticks ahead
- Added Growth Tick Timer and Greenhouse HUD: works for multiple ticks, you need to set your upgrades for it to work properly
- Added Crop Preview: a screen showing every recorded stage of every crop (with All-in Aloe as an exception for later stages)
- Added `/ma gh` and a key to open the greenhouse screen from anywhere in SkyBlock
- Added Item Requests to the planner: click to pull the missing seeds, crops and soil from your sacks or storage (Enhanced Storage mod specifically)

## Other new features

- Added Appearance: color palettes, transparency, fonts from your computer, a background picture or gif, and presets you can save
- Added Sharing: share your config or your Appearance presets
- Added HUD Editor (`/ma hud`): drag, resize, fade, group and tie HUD elements, with a layout per location
- Added Pickaxe Ability Cooldown: a HUD element, with an optional ready warning
- Added vanilla mobs and more Hypixel mobs to Mob Highlight
- Added Highlight Markers (extension pack): icons and edge arrows for highlighted mobs that are far away or off screen
- Added Smol People: draws players visually smaller
- Added time on island to Safari Helper messages

## Changes

- Redesigned the config screen: categories on the side, search, and settings in foldable groups
- Screens adapt to GUI scale and window size
- Errors inside the mod are reported in chat with a copyable report instead of crashing the game
- `/ma version` always checks for the newest version

## Fixes

- Fixed the local player being outlined by Mob Highlight
- Fixed fonts from the computer not being found on Linux

releases.notes:
- Mob Highlight now needs the MagicAddons Extension Pack: drop magicaddons-extension-1.4.0.jar into your mods folder next to the main jar to get it back
- Without the pack, features that need it are hidden from the config, the commands and the screens; their settings are kept and come back when the pack is installed
- The extension pack is one jar for both Minecraft versions, attached to every release

readmeSummary: MagicAddons is a Fabric mod for Hypixel SkyBlock, currently has a lot of greenhouse features, with some other ones.
